# Golden fixtures of the knowledge core

Each folder is a learning folder in format version 1 with the file or folder `expected` beside it. The TypeScript tests in `server/src/learn/knowledge/golden.test.ts` read them, and the Python harvester and the skill should test parity against the same files. Copy a case to a temporary folder before reading it. The cases and the rules they pin are listed in `docs/learning/knowledge.md`.

The ledgers carry no format stamp, because the legacy shape has none.
